property_tests.description: For any invocation of open_knowledge_store, read_only is always supplied as an explicit keyword argument; omitting it always raises TypeError before any I/O regardless of other arguments.

property_tests.invariant_check: _migrate_legacy_files call count == 0 inside assemble_context; index_errata_from_markdown call count == 0 inside assemble_context; all SQL executed on conn are SELECT statements; db state unchanged after call

property_tests.description: For any invocation of _migrate_legacy_files or index_errata_from_markdown at orchestrator startup, running either function multiple times with identical inputs produces no duplicate records and no errors.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Arbitrary number of repeated calls N >= 2 with the same (conn, spec_dir, spec_name) or (conn, project_root) arguments
property_tests.invariant_check: record_count after N calls == record_count after 1 call; no exception raised on any call; all calls return successfully
